description:
Extract clean, boilerplate-free readable text from one known public HTTP(S) URL for LLM research or RAG ingestion; private, local, authenticated, paywalled, or blocked resources are not supported.
USE WHEN: agent already knows the URL and needs clean page text.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent needs web search, multi-page research, comparison, structured web workflow, or change detection.
USE web-intelligence FOR: those broader live-web operations.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) page URL to fetch. Private, local, authenticated, paywalled, or blocked resources are not supported.
url.title: Url
